t: This is Blythe House, a Grade II listed building at 23 Blythe Road in West Kensington. It was built as the headquarters of the Post Office Savings Bank, and later served as a store and archive for the Victoria and Albert, Science and British Museums. In 2015 the Government announced it would fund new storage for the museums and then sell the building. Its architect was Sir Henry Tanner, a prominent British architect of the late nineteenth and early twentieth century, who worked for HM Office of Works.
